font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-numeric: normal; line-height: 1.7; margin: 1.5em 0px 2em;\"\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EA 52 year old male farmer my occupation presented to the opd with chief complaint of bilateral swelling in lower limbs since 3 days\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHistory of presenting illness\u003C\/u\u003E:\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week back then he developed\u003C\/span\u003E\u0026nbsp;bilateral swelling over legs since 1 week, which started near the foot and gradually progressed to the knee. It was pitting type which resolved in between and again started 3 days back.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe had similar complaints in the past for which he went to a local hospital and was advised on taking salt and water restricted diet.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatient on telmesartan for hypertension since 2 years.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003EHe is a chronic alcoholic and smoker.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
